description.value: At 2nd level, the chocobo knight gains and bestows special effects while displaying a banner. He also obtains a free mundane banner. This ability affects the chocobo knight and all allies that see him and his banner (limited to within 60 feet if there are more than 10 allies). The chocobo knight may swap which banner effect he has active as a full-round action outside of combat while undisturbed. Active banner abilities are used by waving the banner (or the relevant weapon or shield) as a standard action. Available banner abilities include Fleet Standard, Inspiring Standard, Jinx Standard, Knave Standard, and Stalwart Standard.
